summary: Round 2 results review passes with no blocking findings. Every required artifact named in the contract is present under notes/mfx_expand10_100k_20261109 (preflight.json, pilot-verification.json, verification.json, files.json, generation-summary.json, status-validated.json, job-log.txt, slurm-accounting.txt, evidence-index.json) and the full 15.5 MB native manifest is available at build/100k-review-evidence/generation.json with a copy index whose SHA equals the generation_sha256 recorded in verification.json, files.json and generation-summary.json. The runtime evidence satisfies every acceptance bullet in scope.md: four unit tests OK in the native job log (closes HUNK-005); 23-event partial-cycle pilot on the tiny fixture with 736 layout checks and 352 witnesses over 11 seam/tail events; preflight expected_file_bytes 376,806,534,528 equals the verified total and the sum of the 20 per-file byte counts; 100,847 records per stream in all ten streams; 100,000 events, one run, one step, 3,200,000 panel checks (32 per event) and 1,280 seed witnesses (40 events x 32 panels); all_datagram_payloads_verified true; per-file SHA256 in verification.json, files.json, generation-summary.json and the full manifest are identical; Slurm job 44025856 COMPLETED 0:0 in 42m26s on sdfmilan271 with MaxRSS 711 MB, consistent with the 2478.9 s campaign elapsed recorded in status-validated.json, which remains accepted=false / validated_review_pending as the code requires. The full manifest contains exactly 100,847 plan entries, exactly 100,000 service-12 entries, no cycle index beyond 9, and the seven transitions only at cycle 0 (2,4,6,8) and cycle 9 (9,7,5) at +1000/+2000/+3000 ns after event 99999. The cycle-0/cycle-1 seam arithmetic was recomputed by hand from the manifest and matches: event 10000 timestamp equals event 9999 timestamp + 1000 ns gap + the base offset of event 0 from body row 0. Per-stream sizes relative to the accepted 10k receipts differ from 10x by exactly 9 x the once-only transition bytes in every stream and in total, consistent with repeating only the enabled body. Source and tiny receipts (c45d191b..., 0d9a6aab...) and the frozen calibration manifest hash are pinned and re-checked in preflight, after pilot and after verify. Panel identity lists in the manifest cover all 32 panels across streams 5-9. README and the small-dgram proposal correctly state that the 100k fixture enlarges the total working set and duration while per-batch JF input at batch 100 stays about 320 MiB (100 x 3,358,200 B) and that gpu_bulk_target_bytes stays 512 KiB; no GPU performance, calibration or cold-FFB bandwidth claim is made. Partial independence of the validator (shared index_source and xtc_fixture helpers; independent schedule derivation and byte comparison) is disclosed in round-1 review but not in the fixture's own README/verification limitations, raised as a low documentation item. HUNK-001 is resolved by the completed job; the five contract-permitted optional deferrals (TENK-002, TENK-003, HUNK-002, HUNK-003, HUNK-004) remain open as low, non-blocking. Scope acceptance is complete from the reviewer's side; coordinator may publish closure.
